name: xstate-v5-json
title: XState v5-style JSON config as an agent

origin.source: New example for bringing an existing XState v5 machine config

comparison.purpose: Runs a v5-style machine kept as JSON (string targets, named actions and guards, invoke by src name) on XState v6: the code supplies the model request, input, assigns and guards by name, and the agent runtime runs it.
